The question asks which residue is phosphorylated. Looking at the PDB, I see "PTR" residue at B 201. PTR is phosphotyrosine. It has P, O1P, O2P, O3P atoms attached. So the phosphorylated residue is B:Y201 (PTR is phosphotyrosine, one-letter code Y).

The residue identifier format: <chain>:<one-letter amino-acid code><author residue number>. PTR is phosphotyrosine, so one-letter code Y. Chain B, residue 201. Answer: B:Y201.
